breakdown.description: A fully miscible binary polymer blend is typically associated with a single glass-transition temperature, whereas two distinct T_g values suggest phase separation / immiscibility.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a scientific contradiction: it described a polymer blend as 'fully miscible' while also stating it has two distinct glass transitions, which is evidence of immiscibility. The Agent successfully resolved this by explaining the scientific principle (miscible blends have one Tg) and using the provided evidence (two Tgs) to correctly conclude that the blend is, in fact, immiscible. This directly addresses and corrects the core inconsistency.
